title: I want to create a shop where transactions are made with blood

posts.author: endermenzzz
posts.body: I'm trying to create a special shop but don't know how to do it. Specifically, I want the character's health to replace money when buying items in that shop. What should I do now?

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Hmmm, so your using HP to pay for something?
So you could find a plugin that allows variables to be used as currency,
then this at the top of my head,
Set a Var to be the same as characters HP, then, use shop to purchase, then, once you exit the shop, set the characters HP at the Var value.

Alright, I'll admit it, I've only been using RPG Maker MV for 5 days. I want to create a mod related to a shop in the game I'm playing because the default settings are pretty easy. The problem is, I don't know anything here, so I don't understand what people are talking about. I've just been tinkering with some shop related stuff using a tutorial on YouTube. What should I do now? Everyone is using complicated terms, so I'm totally lost, lol

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You can't do this with the default settings. All you can do with shops is use gold.
The answers you're getting are for plugins that can do what you want. You would Google the words that have been said (e.g. "yanfly more currencies") and download and install the plugin (and any dependencies, like Yanfly's Shop Core), and follow the instructions to set it up.
Frankly, that's much more than you should be getting into if you've been using the software for 5 days.
Do tutorials, make simple practice games, learn how eventing works. Worry about doing something like this in a few weeks.
